complexity: points: the product of (degree + 1) per input times the sum of the recurrence orders
decides: equality of two integer functions on their domain, when both forms fall in a class with a finite-witness theorem
limits: only straight-line polynomials and single counted loops with constant-coefficient affine updates; the lifter's faithfulness is assumed; machine integers are not covered
name: sized_witness
procedure: Read both forms' classes from their lifted IR (polynomial, C-finite in one counted loop, regions cut by leading guards), size the witness by the theorems for those classes, and run both forms on it with exact integers.
